narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The laminated reference chart"**

The site reads like a chart pinned beside a workbench. A cool off-white ground, near-black ink and four flat category colours do the wayfinding. Rules do the structure. Diagrams carry the behaviour. Nothing floats, nothing glows, and nothing is decorated for its own sake.

Density is high on purpose. The reader is mid-task on a second screen, so every page is a lookup surface: a left rail of topics grouped by colour, a right rail of methods, and a centre column of rule-separated method entries with a small diagram each. Colour is reserved for meaning: which group a page belongs to, whether a method mutates, and which part of a flow is input, process or output.
keyCharacteristics: Flat category fills on a cool off-white ground.
1px rules divide, 3px ink bars head sections, a 6px group-colour bar closes each page title.
Square corners on every built component.
Archivo for all text, JetBrains Mono for code only.
Mutation is coded twice: colour plus a filled or open dot.

rules.name: The Inverted Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every Tailwind hue ramp is remapped to the chart palette and inverted for a light ground: steps 50 to 400 are ink-dark, 500 is the full hue, 600 to 950 are tints. `white` is ink and `black` is a paper shade. Write new markup against these meanings; `text-white` renders ink, not white.

rules.name: The Colour Means Something Rule
rules.body: Group colours mark group membership, mutation colours mark mutation, flow colours mark flow roles. A colour never appears as decoration. The two system exceptions are saffron selection and the cobalt focus ring.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Mutation always pairs colour with a glyph: a filled dot for mutates, an open dot for immutable, drawn as inline SVG.

rules.name: The Mono Is Code Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets code, method names, signatures and array values. It never sets prose, labels or navigation.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below 0.75rem. The theme lifts legacy 9 to 11px label classes to 0.75rem in one place.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with three rule weights only: 1px hairline to divide, 3px ink to head a section or the index, 6px group colour to close a page title.

dos: Do take colour from the theme tokens (`ground`, `ink`, `rule`, `group-*`, `mutates`, `immutable`) and read every ramp step through the Inverted Ramp Rule.
Do mark a new topic with its group colour in exactly the existing places: nav swatch, active fill, index band, 6px title bar.
Do pair mutation colour with the filled or open dot.
Do keep components square and flat, separated by 1px hairlines.
Do strip leading emoji from any slotted or rendered rail content.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows or lifted cards.
Don't nest cards; a note or diagram well sits directly in the method entry.
Don't use the periodic-element motif: no symbol tiles, no atomic numbers.
Don't return to dark navy card stacks or emoji headings.
Don't set prose or labels in JetBrains Mono.
